description: Limited did:web and Ed25519 eddsa-jcs-2022 verifier for public DNS domains. Fetches same-domain DID and credential with public-address DNS screening, no redirects, size/time limits and strict proof checks. Validates one standalone proof, not proof chains, revocation or commercial truth. No OAuth, carts, customer data or payment access. Unsupported documents are reported, not guessed valid.

credential_url.description: Optional HTTPS same-domain URL under /.well-known/, without query, fragment, port or credentials.

domain.description: Bare public ASCII DNS domain, without scheme or port.

name: verify_merchant_identity
